summary: Return 404 for PATCH and DELETE of missing experiments.
Prevent missing-ID mutations from reporting false CRUD success.
Preserve existing soft-archive behavior for found experiments.
Five runtime route cases also cover successful PATCH payload/tag serialization and missing post-write reread.
limits: VM route harness uses explicit Next/Drizzle/database doubles; no live server or SQLite.
No concurrency or full middleware claim.
DELETE uses a pre-read and does not inspect affected-row count; concurrent disappearance after lookup remains outside this fix.
